items.docs: Executes a GraphQL query or mutation against the Traceable platform. Supports queries for entities, vulnerabilities, threat activity, explore datasets, API testing data, analytics batches, and authentication hooks. Use the Authorization header with your platform API token.

Executes a tool via the Traceable MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. The MCP server exposes 12 tools for AI-assisted security workflows including attribute mappings, GraphQL query templates, threat activity time ranges, vulnerability filter values, sensitive data type details, and trend data calculation.
